method.process: One fresh public producer then one separate fresh public receiver per size, serial. Imports, empty owner, input/prior/built baselines are separate; no foreign engine or changed limits.
method.observer: Separate worker connectToMainThread debugger with exact compiled source SHA/line/function/order checks. HeapProfiler.takeHeapSnapshot streams the paused main-isolate dump into the observer-owned file; no reportProgress option. Marker deleted before resume. Worker heap excluded from dump, included in process RSS.
method.graph: Same-snapshot selected property/element/backing/frozen-array numeric/string-parent edges, excluding prototypes/maps/other internal/weak/hidden edges. Per-stage roles distinguish current state, actual chunks/encoding input, primitive body/envelope/input strings, decoded value and candidate state. Masks deduplicate shared graphs; no cross-snapshot ID comparisons.
method.strings: String-node self-size/backing relationships are observed representation. Lengths/UTF8/checksum/file bytes are separate diagnostics, never physical copies, isolated allocated bytes or proof of string collection.
method.cleanup: Observer exits; three setImmediate/explicit GC/25ms cycles before listed object-only WeakRefs, held/released controls and public disposal. Primitive strings have no WeakRef targets.
method.instrumentation: Breakpoints/lexical inspection/GC/dumping can deopt/materialize/change use. Heap snapshot streaming allocates in observer/runtime; no guessed subtraction. One intrusive run per size/role and selected points do not locate allocation high-water, synchronous join peak or internal transport copies.
method.preserved: Earlier repeated sampled producer/receiver/browser/mutation work remains frozen; no promotion to allocation peaks. No browser engine worker, source-format/positions codec, physical input, AT, native portability or publication claim.
method.environment: Only PATH/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL inherited by180-second bounded owned children. Full synthetic-corpus heaps and encoding files stay in task-owned temp.

summary.meaning: One-snapshot selected-edge node self-sizes, including VM representation overhead. Codec-only means absent from selected state graph, never allocation, physical copies, exact retention, freed bytes or peak.
